Badge

A small, non-interactive label that conveys status, category or count. Six semantic colours map straight to the success / warning / danger / info / important / neutral tokens.

6 colourssubtle · solid · darkToken-driven

Preview

Active Pending Failed Beta Important Draft

Colours

Each colour carries meaning — pick by intent, not by look.
Success
Successpositive / done
Warning
Warningcaution
Danger
Dangererror / failed
Info
Infoneutral note
Important
Importantneeds attention
Neutral
Neutraldefault

Subtle vs Solid

Subtle (tinted background) is the default for in-page status. Solid is for higher emphasis — use sparingly.
Subtle Active Pending Failed Beta Important Draft
Solid Active Pending Failed Beta Important Draft

Dark mode

On dark backgrounds (footers, dark hero sections), put the badge inside a .dark ancestor — the semantic subtle/strong tokens swap to the Dark Purple pair automatically, no per-badge class.
Active Pending Failed Beta Important Draft

With dot · sizes · shape

A leading status dot, two sizes, and a pill variant for a softer look.
Online Offline
Default Small
Squared Pill

Code

          
<Badge intent="success" dot>Active</Badge>
<Badge intent="warning">Pending</Badge>
<Badge intent="info" solid>Beta</Badge>
<Badge intent="important">Important</Badge>
<Badge intent="neutral" pill>Draft</Badge>
<Badge intent="info" size="sm">Small</Badge>

<!-- dark mode: no prop — a .dark ancestor re-themes every badge -->
<div class="dark"><Badge intent="success">Active</Badge></div>

Guidelines

✓ Do
Paid Overdue Archived
  • Match colour to meaning (green = good, red = error).
  • Keep labels to 1–2 words.
  • Use subtle by default; reserve solid for emphasis.
  • Use .dark on dark backgrounds instead of the light-mode subtle fill.
✗ Don't
Click here to retry now
  • Don't make badges clickable — that's a Button or link.
  • Don't write sentences inside a badge.
  • Don't pick colours for looks; pick by intent token.
